statement: Broadcom's reported AI semiconductor demand is accelerating, but its supply and financing exposure has expanded far faster than its historical commitment base.
caveat: The 126.821B purchase-commitment stock, 179.2B RPO and 29B maximum backstop have different counterparties, timing and accounting; they must not be summed as debt or treated as recognized revenue. Strong cash generation mitigates but does not remove delivery and customer-credit risk.

statement: No defensible Broadcom supplier content per matched IT GW or revenue per effective utilized IT MW can be calculated from current public disclosures.
caveat: Announced future GW do not identify the Q3 shipment cohort, period-average active IT load, physical utilization or customer-site energy. The reported 16.7B numerator also combines custom accelerators and networking.

statement: Broadcom's XPV model transfers upfront rack funding to private capital but leaves Broadcom with material contingent customer-credit and collateral-value exposure.
caveat: The 29B amount is an undiscounted maximum after full deployment, not an expected loss. Liability depends on customer default, 85% of outstanding backstopped lease amounts, rack resale value and contractual remedies; no notes had been issued and no backstop payments made at quarter-end.
